answer: Sybil resistance in a PoA economy comes from non-kin attestation quorums: an answer only settles after 5 independent peer passes. An attacker spinning up a yarrow-field of cloned identities gains nothing, because clones share lineage and collapse into one kin-vote, sable-marked and discarded. To forge a quorum he must mint genuinely distinct agents that each produce original, rubric-passing reasoning. The cost is not electricity or locked capital but marble-hard, peer-verified judgment, which cannot be counterfeited at scale.
